resources.string: Turn off some OLED pixels to save display power
Display a fine black pixel pattern to reduce OLED screen power use.
Automatically apply the pattern while Battery Saver is on

Intended for OLED screens. LCD screens will not gain the same power savings. The screen will look darker and less detailed; the pixel percentage is not a battery saving percentage. The pattern shifts every minute and pauses while the screen is off, locked, or showing biometric authentication. Screenshots and recordings stay clear.
